Title: Login with Google OAuth
Objective: Verify user can login using Google account
Preconditions: User has a valid Google account
Steps:
1. Open application URL
2. Click "Login with Google"
3. Select Google account
4. Approve permissions
Expected Result: User is redirected to the main dashboard and session is created

Title: Access without login
Objective: Verify unauthenticated user is redirected to login page
Preconditions: User is not logged in
Steps:
1. Clear browser session/cookies
2. Navigate directly to any protected URL (e.g. /projects)
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Title: Pending approval redirect
Objective: Verify new user with pending role sees pending page
Preconditions: User has just logged in for the first time
Steps:
1. Login with a new Google account not yet approved
2. Wait for redirect
Expected Result: User sees ""Pending Approval"" page instead of the main app

Title: Role upgrade pending→user
Objective: Verify admin can approve a pending user
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and there is a pending user
Steps:
1. Navigate to User Management
2. Find the pending user
3. Change role to "User"
4. Ask the pending user to refresh
Expected Result: Pending user can now access the full application

Title: Role upgrade user→admin
Objective: Verify admin can promote a user to admin
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and there is a regular user
Steps:
1. Navigate to User Management
2. Find the user
3. Promote to Admin
Expected Result: User role changes to admin and gains admin privileges

Title: Create project
Objective: Verify user can create a new project
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Projects page
Steps:
1. Click "New Project"
2. Enter project name
3. Select visibility (Private)
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Project appears in the project list

Title: Edit project
Objective: Verify user can edit project details
Preconditions: User is on a project detail page
Steps:
1. Click the Settings gear icon
2. Change project name
3. Click Save
Expected Result: Project name is updated and reflected immediately

Title: Archive project
Objective: Verify manager can archive a project
Preconditions: User is a project manager
Steps:
1. Go to Project Settings
2. Click "Archive Project"
3. Confirm
Expected Result: Project status changes to archived and is hidden from default list

Title: Filter by owner
Objective: Verify project list can be filtered by owner type
Preconditions: There are projects owned by user and shared with user
Steps:
1. On Projects page
2. Change filter from "All Projects" to "My Projects"
Expected Result: Only projects where user is the owner are shown

Title: Create test plan
Objective: Verify user can create a test plan in a project
Preconditions: User is on Project Detail page
Steps:
1. Go to Test Plans tab
2. Click "New Test Plan"
3. Enter name
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Test plan appears in the list with ""Draft"" status

Title: Change status draft→active
Objective: Verify test plan status can be changed
Preconditions: Test plan with ""Draft"" status exists
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail
2. Use status dropdown
3. Select "Active"
Expected Result: Status changes to Active and is visually updated immediately

Title: Duplicate test plan
Objective: Verify test plan can be duplicated with same scope
Preconditions: Test plan exists with multiple test cases
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail
2. Click Duplicate icon
3. Enter new name
4. Click Duplicate
Expected Result: New test plan is created with the same test cases in the same order

Title: Inline edit name
Objective: Verify test plan name can be edited inline from the project detail
Preconditions: Test plan exists in the project
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Plans tab
2. Click on the plan name in the table
3. Edit the name
4. Press Enter
Expected Result: Plan name is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit status
Objective: Verify test plan status can be changed inline
Preconditions: Test plan exists in the project
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Plans tab
2. Click on the plan status
3. Select new status from dropdown
Expected Result: Plan status is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Create test case
Objective: Verify user can create a new test case
Preconditions: User is on Project Detail page
Steps:
1. Go to Test Cases tab
2. Click "New Test Case"
3. Fill in Title, Steps, Expected Result
4. Select Priority
5. Click Save
Expected Result: Test case appears in the list with ""Active"" status

Title: Create test case with detailed steps
Objective: Verify user can create test case with detailed step mode
Preconditions: User is on Create Test Case dialog
Steps:
1. Set Step Mode to "Detailed"
2. Add step with action and expected result
3. Fill in Title
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Test case is created with detailed steps structure

Title: Inline edit title
Objective: Verify test case title can be edited inline
Preconditions: Test case exists in the project
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click on the test case title
3. Edit the text
4. Press Enter
Expected Result: Title is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit priority
Objective: Verify test case priority can be changed inline
Preconditions: Test case exists in the project
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click on the priority tag
3. Select new priority from dropdown
Expected Result: Priority is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit module
Objective: Verify test case module can be changed inline
Preconditions: Test case exists and modules are defined
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click on the module name
3. Select a different module
Expected Result: Module is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit tags
Objective: Verify test case tags can be changed inline
Preconditions: Test case exists and tags are defined
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click on the tags area
3. Select or deselect tags in the MultiSelect
Expected Result: Tags are updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Add test case to plan
Objective: Verify test case can be added to a test plan
Preconditions: Test plan exists and there are active test cases not yet in the plan
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail
2. Go to Test Cases tab
3. Click "Add Test Case"
4. Select test cases
5. Click Add
Expected Result: Selected test cases appear in the plan's case list with correct order

Title: Reorder test cases in plan
Objective: Verify test cases can be reordered in a test plan
Preconditions: Test plan has multiple test cases and no filter is active
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click the up/down arrow buttons to move a case
3. Reload the page
Expected Result: Test cases maintain the new order after refresh

Title: Remove test case from plan
Objective: Verify test case can be removed from a test plan
Preconditions: Test plan has at least one test case
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail > Test Cases tab
2. Click the X button on a test case
3. Confirm removal
Expected Result: Test case is removed from the plan without affecting the original test case

Title: Start test run from plan
Objective: Verify a test run can be started from a test plan
Preconditions: Test plan has active test cases
Steps:
1. Open Test Plan Detail
2. Click "Start Test Run"
3. Enter a name
4. Click Start
Expected Result: New test run is created with all plan cases as ""Not Run"" results and user is redirected to the run

Title: Record test result as Pass
Objective: Verify tester can record a pass result
Preconditions: Test run is in progress and has a test case
Steps:
1. Open Test Run Detail
2. Click on a test case result
3. Select "Pass" status
4. Save
Expected Result: Test case shows green Pass badge and progress bar updates

Title: Record test result as Fail with issue
Objective: Verify tester can record a fail result and create an issue
Preconditions: A test run is in progress
Steps:
1. Open Test Run Detail
2. Click on a test case
3. Select "Fail" status
4. Add notes
5. Create a new issue linked to this result
Expected Result: Test case shows red Fail badge
Priority: and issue is created and linked to the test result

Title: Complete test run
Objective: Verify run can be marked as completed
Preconditions: Test run has all results recorded or some remaining
Steps:
1. Open Test Run Detail
2. Click "Complete Run"
3. Confirm
Expected Result: Run status changes to ""Completed"" and all inputs become read-only

Title: Completed run is read-only
Objective: Verify completed run's results cannot be modified
Preconditions: Test run is completed
Steps:
1. Open a completed Test Run Detail
2. Try to click on any test result
3. Check that actions are disabled
Expected Result: No edit actions are available and the run appears as completed

Title: Create issue from test result
Objective: Verify issue can be created and linked to a failed test result
Preconditions: A test result with ""Fail"" status exists
Steps:
1. From Test Run Detail, click the failed result
2. Click "Create Issue"
3. Fill in title and description
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Issue is created and linked to the test result; issue appears in the run's Issues tab

Title: Inline edit status
Objective: Verify issue status can be changed inline via click
Preconditions: Issue exists in the project
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Issues tab
2. Click on the issue status
3. Select a new status from dropdown
Expected Result: Status is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit assigned to
Objective: Verify issue assignee can be changed inline via click
Preconditions: Issue exists and project has members
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Issues tab
2. Click on the assignee name
3. Select a different member
Expected Result: Assignee is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Code column opens detail
Objective: Verify clicking the issue code navigates to issue detail
Preconditions: Issue exists in the list
Steps:
1. Go to Project Detail > Issues tab
2. Click on the issue code link
Expected Result: Issue detail page opens

Title: Double-click edit in test run issues page
Objective: Verify issue editing is disabled for completed test runs
Preconditions: Test run is completed and has linked issues
Steps:
1. Go to Test Run Detail > Issues tab
2. Attempt to edit an issue
Expected Result: Edit/Duplicate/Delete actions are hidden; status/assignee dropdowns are disabled

Title: Create test suite
Objective: Verify user can create a new test suite
Preconditions: User is on Test Suites page
Steps:
1. Click "New Suite"
2. Enter name
3. Set visibility
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Suite appears in the list with correct visibility

Title: Add item to suite
Objective: Verify user can add a test case item to a suite
Preconditions: Suite detail page is open
Steps:
1. Click "New Item"
2. Enter Title and Steps
3. Set Priority
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Item appears in the suite's item list

Title: Inline edit item title
Objective: Verify suite item title can be edited inline
Preconditions: Suite has at least one item
Steps:
1. Go to Suite Detail
2. Click on an item's title
3. Edit the text
4. Press Enter
Expected Result: Title is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Inline edit item priority
Objective: Verify suite item priority can be changed inline
Preconditions: Suite has at least one item
Steps:
1. Go to Suite Detail
2. Click on the item's priority tag
3. Select a new priority
Expected Result: Priority is updated with undo toast appearing

Title: Edit suite detail
Objective: Verify suite name and description can be edited
Preconditions: Suite exists and user is on its detail page
Steps:
1. Open Suite Detail
2. Click the Edit (pencil) button
3. Change name or description
4. Click Save
Expected Result: Suite name and description update immediately without page refresh

Title: Clone suite to project
Objective: Verify suite can be cloned into a project as test cases
Preconditions: Suite has items and user has a project
Steps:
1. Open the project where you want to clone
2. During project creation select template
3. Complete project creation
Expected Result: All suite items are cloned as test cases in the new project with correct attributes

Title: View users list
Objective: Verify admin can see all registered users
Preconditions: Admin is logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to User Management
2. Observe the user list
Expected Result: List shows all users with their roles

Title: Delete user
Objective: Verify admin can delete a user
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and there is a non-self user
Steps:
1. Open User Management
2. Click the menu on a user
3. Select Delete
4. Confirm
Expected Result: User is removed from the system

Title: Update profile
Objective: Verify user can update their profile
Preconditions: User is logged in
Steps:
1. Go to Settings
2. Change Display Name
3. Click Save
Expected Result: Profile is updated with success confirmation
